tools.name: servicebridge_whoami
tools.description: Show the API user and the account profile the connection uses. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Users/Current.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, with optional name or text search. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Customers.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts, optionally for one customer or location. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Contacts.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_locations
tools.description: List service locations (job sites), optionally for one customer. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Locations.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders, filtered by date range, customer, location or status. ServiceBridge REST: GET /WorkOrders.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_work_order
tools.description: Get one work order by id, with its visits and lines. ServiceBridge REST: GET /WorkOrders/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes), filtered by date range, customer or status. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Estimates.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by id, with its visits and lines. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Estimates/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filtered by date range, customer or status. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Invoices.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Invoices/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_payments
tools.description: List customer payments, filtered by date range or status. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Payments.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, filtered by due date, branch, team, status or priority. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Tasks.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Tasks/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_leads
tools.description: List sales leads, filtered by text, status, source or date. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Leads.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_lead
tools.description: Get one sales lead by id. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Leads/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (technicians and staff), filtered by branch, team or status. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Employees.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_activity_notes
tools.description: List activity notes, filtered by customer, job, invoice, payment or location. ServiceBridge REST: GET /ActivityNote.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_teams
tools.description: List dispatch teams, optionally for one branch. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Teams.

tools.name: servicebridge_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods set up in the account. ServiceBridge REST: GET /PaymentMethods.

tools.name: servicebridge_get_invoice_statistics
tools.description: Get invoice totals for a period, grouped by granularity. ServiceBridge REST: GET /Statistics/Invoices.

tools.name: servicebridge_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: POST /Customers.

tools.name: servicebridge_update_customer
tools.description: Change a customer's name, type or notes. Only the fields you pass change. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: PUT /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: servicebridge_create_lead
tools.description: Create a sales lead. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: POST /Leads.

tools.name: servicebridge_create_task
tools.description: Create a task, optionally for a customer. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: POST /Tasks.

tools.name: servicebridge_add_activity_note
tools.description: Add an activity note to a customer, job, invoice or location. Writes to the account. ServiceBridge REST: POST /ActivityNote.
